headline: Control AirTouch 5 ducted air conditioning
intro: Connect an AirTouch 5 controller to Home Assistant to control ducted air conditioning systems. The integration creates a climate entity for each AC unit and zone, plus a cover entity for each zone's damper.
highlights: Add AirTouch 5 from Settings > Devices & services by selecting Add integration and following the on-screen instructions
Get a climate entity for each AC unit and each zone
See each zone's damper state through its cover entity; manual damper adjustments are not recommended in zones with a temperature sensor because AirTouch 5 automatically controls the damper

flow.title: From AirTouch 5 controller to climate and damper entities
stages: Open Settings > Devices & services in Home Assistant
Select Add integration, search for AirTouch 5, and follow the on-screen setup instructions
Use the climate entities for AC units and zones, and cover entities to represent zone damper state
